reasoning_content: `process list` shows just names. Let me use the API or `process-compose process` with more options. Maybe `process-compose process list -o json`.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" && process-compose process list -o json 2>&1 | grep -v "level" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(p['name'], p.get('status'), p.get('exit_code')) for p in d]" 2>&1 | head -60

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && export PATH=\"$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH\" && process-compose process list -o json 2>&1 | grep -v \"level\" | python3 -c \"import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(p['name'], p.get('status'), p.get('exit_code')) for p in d]\" 2>&1 | head -60", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Get process statuses as JSON"}
